functionDeclarations.name: search_pharmacy_catalog
functionDeclarations.description: Search Zeytun's catalog by exactly one key. Candidates are unverified; listPrice is for one unit (per).

text.description: Name and details as spoken, at most 240 characters.

functionDeclarations.name: calculate_order_total
functionDeclarations.description: Exact total of lines looked up in this call with listPrice. Read back only what it returns.

functionDeclarations.name: save_order_list
functionDeclarations.description: Save the whole list so far, resolved or not: after every line that is settled, and once more with final true when the caller has nothing to add. An ordinary save returns recorded: say nothing. Only the final save returns saved with orderNumber, or queued.

unit.description: The caller's unit: qutu, ədəd, flakon, ...

spoken.description: The caller's words, at most 160 characters.

final.description: true only after the caller confirmed the whole order (təsdiq edin, bu qədər); never per line. Only a final order goes to the pharmacy on WhatsApp.

functionDeclarations.name: transfer_to_manager
functionDeclarations.description: Only when the caller asks for a person. transferring: say exactly its say text, then nothing. unavailable: no manager now; keep taking the order.

functionDeclarations.name: cancel_order
functionDeclarations.description: Cancel the whole order, only after the caller asked to cancel (ləğv, отмена) and said yes to "Sifarişi ləğv edək?". təsdiq or подтверждаю confirms the order: finish it, never ask about cancelling. cancelled: say its say text, then the closing. not_confirmed: the order stays; say so. not_cancelled: it is with the manager already.
